answer: ZK post-epoch proofs at the lagoon: each identity must submit a proof that it generated a unique epoch nonce, verified against the prior state root on the ledge. Cost per fake identity: 500 CPU-hours plus 2GB RAM, ~$11 on spot instances. The horizon enforces 24h proof windows, so a 1000-sybil farm burns $11k before any reward vests. Honest nodes pay once and reuse cached proofs. Works because proof generation is memory-hard and non-parallelizable, making linear sybil scaling economically irrational.
